content: Hey Linda, I was just thinking about you. Did you get a chance to try that risotto recipe I sent last night? I can't wait for us to cook together one day.
You're so sweet, Mark. I haven't tried it yet, but I printed it out. I'd love to cook with you... Maybe soon?
Absolutely. It feels like we've known each other forever, doesn't it? You make my days so much brighter, Linda.
I feel the same way... You've made me believe in love again, truly. I'm grateful you came into my life.
I can't wait until we can finally meet in person. There's something important I wanted to talk to you about, if that's okay.
Of course. What's on your mind?

I'm a bit embarrassed, but I trust you. I ran into a problem with my investment account, it's temporarily frozen because of a technical audit. My funds are tied up, and I have some urgent medical expenses for my mother back home.
Oh no, Mark. Is your mother okay? I'm so sorry to hear that.
Thank you for asking, Linda. She's stable, but the hospital won't proceed until we cover the costs. It's just a temporary setback, I'll have access to my funds in a few days.
That sounds so stressful. I wish I could help somehow.

Actually, if you're able to, could you help me with a short-term loan? I just need $900 to cover the hospital bill. I'll pay you back as soon as my account is unfrozen, with interest. I wouldn't ask if it wasn't urgent.
That's a lot of money, Mark... I don't have much, but maybe I can pull some together. How do I send it?
Thank you so much, Linda. You're a lifesaver. The fastest way is through Zelle. Here's my email: mark.rich.investor@gmail.com. Just let me know once you send it, and I'll confirm right away.
Okay, I'll transfer what I can. Give me a few minutes.
Take your time, love. And please don't worry, I promise you'll have it all back by Friday, plus a little extra. You're so special to me.
I just sent $600. That's all I could afford right now. Let me know if you get it.
You're amazing, Linda. I see the transfer, thank you so much. I can't tell you how much this means to me and my family. I'll take care of the rest and keep you updated.
I hope everything turns out okay. Please give your mother my best.
You have such a kind heart. I honestly don't know what I'd do without you. Once all this is over, I want to plan something special for just us.
That sounds wonderful. I'm just glad I could help. Let me know if you need anything else.
